ERR_MISSING_ASSET: Required game data could not be loaded. Please reinstall or update the game.
SAVE_RECOVERED: Your save data was damaged and has been restored.
MENU_TAGLINE: Restore the power. Retrieve the sample. Get out alive.
PLAY_JOIN_CODE: Join with an online code (ABC123), a LAN code or an IP address
PLAY_JOIN_HINT: The host shares the code shown in their lobby. Online codes work from any network.
MISSION_POWER_RESTORATION_DESC: Kessler Research Facility went dark six hours ago. Restore power, recover the containment sample and evacuate. Something is still moving inside.
OBJ_ENTER_FACILITY_HINT: Get through the entrance and reach the security checkpoint.
OBJ_LOCATE_MAINTENANCE_HINT: Maintenance is off the main corridor, east wing.
OBJ_FIND_COMPONENTS_HINT: Search lockers and cabinets in storage, the labs and the generator room.
OBJ_REPAIR_PANEL_HINT: Install the components. Repairs are loud.
OBJ_START_GENERATOR_HINT: The generator will be heard across the facility.
OBJ_ACCESS_SECURITY_HINT: Use a security terminal to locate an access card.
OBJ_OBTAIN_ACCESS_HINT: The terminal flagged where the keycard was last logged.
OBJ_REACH_UNDERGROUND_HINT: Take the elevator or the maintenance stairwell.
OBJ_CONTAINMENT_HINT: Hold the console until the extraction cycle completes.
OBJ_SECURE_SAMPLE_HINT: Someone has to carry it out.
OBJ_SURVIVE_EVAC_HINT: Head toward the extraction point. Stay together.
OBJ_EXTRACT_HINT: Get to the extraction zone before evac departs.
OBJ_OPT_RESEARCH_HINT: Data drives may be in the labs, server room or archive.
HUD_BEING_REVIVED: A teammate is helping you up...
REASON_LOCKDOWN: Locked down - a crowbar could force it
EVENT_ALARM_BANNER: ALARM TRIGGERED - silence it at security
ITEM_MEDKIT_DESC: Restores a large amount of health. Takes time to apply.
ITEM_KEYCARD_DESC: Level 3 access. Opens keycard locks and the elevator.
ITEM_ACCESS_DECODER_DESC: Bypasses one keycard lock, then burns out.
ITEM_SAMPLE_CASE_DESC: Sealed containment sample. The reason you are here.
ITEM_CROWBAR_DESC: Forces jammed and locked-down doors. Noisy.
ITEM_ARC_EMITTER_DESC: Short-range stun pulse. Uses arc cells.
NOTE_01: SHIFT LOG 02:14 - Containment reports pressure loss in cell 4. Night crew told to stay out of the lower level until morning. Nobody tells us anything.
NOTE_02: To whoever finds this: it does not like the light. It LOOKS for the light. Keep your torch off when you hear the clicking.
NOTE_03: Maintenance memo: panel B fuses blew again. Spares are in storage. If the generator has to be started manually, expect the whole building to hear it.
NOTE_04: Med bay inventory: 3 medkits, 1 missing. Bandages restocked. Dr. Varga asked again for sedatives 'strong enough for something big'.
NOTE_05: Security: keycards were moved during the lockdown drill. The terminal keeps a log of where each card was last scanned.
NOTE_06: It walked past me. I was crouched behind the bench and it walked right past. It was listening. Move slow. Stay low.
NOTE_07: If the evacuation shuttle is called it will only wait ninety seconds. Protocol says no one goes back for stragglers. I hope you have better friends than I did.
RESULT_EXTRACTED: The team extracted from the facility.
PAUSE_ONLINE_NOTE: Online session - the game keeps running.
PAUSE_LEAVE_CONFIRM: Leave the mission? You will not receive extraction rewards. If you are the host, the session ends for everyone.
KIT_STANDARD_DESC: A bandage and a spare battery.
KIT_TECHNICIAN_DESC: Bring a crowbar for jammed doors.
PERK_QUIET_STEPS_DESC: Move more quietly, but sprint slightly slower.
PERK_FIELD_MEDIC_DESC: Revive faster, but have less maximum health.
PERK_LONG_BATTERY_DESC: Flashlight lasts longer, but less stamina.
PERK_MARATHON_DESC: More stamina, but sprinting is louder.
NET_ERR_HOST_FAILED: Could not create a lobby. Check your network connection.
NET_ERR_CONNECT_FAILED: Could not connect to the lobby.
NET_ERR_BAD_CODE: That lobby code is not valid.
NET_ERR_HOST_LOST: Connection to the host was lost.
NET_ERR_VERSION: The host is running a different game version.
NET_ERR_IN_PROGRESS: That mission is already in progress.
NET_ERR_KICKED: You were removed from the lobby.
NET_ERR_LOAD_TIMEOUT: Loading took too long and you were removed from the mission.
LOADING_ONLINE_LOBBY: Opening online lobby... (the server may need up to a minute to wake up)
NET_ERR_NO_RELAY: No online server is configured. Set the relay address in Settings > Gameplay.
NET_ERR_RELAY_UNREACHABLE: Could not reach the online server. Check your internet connection.
NET_ERR_ROOM_NOT_FOUND: No lobby with that code exists (it may have closed).
NET_ERR_RELAY_BUSY: The online server is busy. Please try again shortly.
INTRO_01: 02:47. Kessler Research Facility stopped answering six hours ago.
INTRO_02: No calls. No alarms. Only static on every channel.
INTRO_03: The day staff went home. The night shift never clocked out.
INTRO_04: Something was kept on the lower level. Something that learned to open doors.
INTRO_05: We call it THE HUNTER. It hears every step. It follows the light.
INTRO_06: You are the cleanup crew. Restore power, recover what they left behind, and get out before dawn.
MISSION_SIGNAL_LOST_DESC: The first recovery team went silent at the Greywater harbour cold-storage depot. Find out what happened to them, repair the radio mast and call the boat. The cold slows everything down - except it.
OBJ_ENTER_DEPOT_HINT: The gate is open. The guard post is not answering.
OBJ_DEPOT_GENERATOR_HINT: The backup generator is north of the service corridor. It will be loud.
OBJ_DEPOT_POWER_HINT: Throw the breaker in the generator room to power the depot.
OBJ_FIND_TEAM_LOG: Find the lost team's last log
OBJ_FIND_TEAM_LOG_HINT: Their tracker last pinged inside cold storage. Check the terminals.
OBJ_FIND_RADIO_PARTS: Find parts for the radio mast
OBJ_FIND_RADIO_PARTS_HINT: The log lists what burned out. Search the loading bay and workshops.
OBJ_REPAIR_MAST_HINT: The mast panel is in the yard past the radio room. Bring the parts.
OBJ_SEND_SIGNAL_HINT: Hold the radio console until the boat confirms. Everything will hear it.
OBJ_SURVIVE_BOAT: Hold out until the boat arrives
OBJ_SURVIVE_BOAT_HINT: The boat is coming. Stay alive.
OBJ_EXTRACT_BOAT_HINT: The boat won't wait. Reach the pier on the west quay.
OBJ_OPT_MANIFESTS_HINT: Two data drives with the depot's real cargo list are somewhere inside.
OBJ_OPT_SHIPPING_LOGS_HINT: The harbour office terminal still has the night's shipping records.
NOTE_H01: DOCK LOG 23:40 - Refrigerated container KR-7 arrived from Kessler. Paperwork says 'biological samples'. Nobody signs for it. Container is warm.
NOTE_H02: To whoever reads this: the freezers are not keeping it asleep. It moves between the shelves. Turn off your torch.
NOTE_H03: Recovery team, day 1: arrived 01:10. Mast burned out, generator dry. Splitting up to find parts. Bad idea. Doing it anyway.
NOTE_H04: Radio check every 15 min. 02:15 Novak - ok. 02:30 Ilse - ok. 02:45 Novak - no answer. 03:00 Ilse - no answer.
NOTE_H05: It doesn't like the cold. That's why it stays near the generator. If the power comes back on, so does it.
MISSION_WARD_NINE_DESC: St. Agnes took the first patients from Kessler. Ward Nine stopped reporting at midnight. Find patient zero's file, recover the isolation sample and get out through the ambulance bay.
OBJ_WARD_NINE_REACH_NURSES_HINT: Ward Nine is on the ground floor. Follow the north corridor.
OBJ_WARD_NINE_PATIENT_FILE_HINT: Search the records terminals. One of them still has the file.
OBJ_WARD_NINE_POWER_HINT: The hospital just went dark. The main breaker is in the plant room.
OBJ_WARD_NINE_ISOLATION_KEY_HINT: The file says the head nurse carried it. Check the offices.
OBJ_WARD_NINE_ISOLATION_HINT: Hold the isolation console. It will hear the seals release.
OBJ_WARD_NINE_SECURE_SAMPLE_HINT: Whoever carries the case is slower and louder. Cover them.
OBJ_WARD_NINE_CALL_EVAC_HINT: The chaplain's office has the emergency radio.
OBJ_WARD_NINE_EXTRACT_HINT: East side of the hospital. Go!
OBJ_WARD_NINE_OPT_DRIVES_HINT: Two drives with the clinical trial data are hidden in the wards.
NOTE_WARD_NINE_1: CHART, BED 4: Transferred from Kessler 21:30. Temp 34.1. Does not blink. Restrained at 23:00 after biting orderly.
NOTE_WARD_NINE_2: Night nurse: the isolation door was locked from the INSIDE. I have the only key. I'm not opening it.
NOTE_WARD_NINE_3: Morgue log: drawer 7 was empty at 01:00. Drawer 7 was full at 00:30.
MISSION_LAST_TRAIN_DESC: Westgate station on Line 4 is the last way out of the city centre. Restore the substation, repair the signal relay and call the last train before the tunnels fill with what came up from below.
OBJ_LAST_TRAIN_REACH_PLATFORM_HINT: Through the ticket hall and down to the platforms.
OBJ_LAST_TRAIN_GENERATOR_HINT: The substation is north of the main corridor.
OBJ_LAST_TRAIN_POWER_HINT: Throw the main breaker next to the generator.
OBJ_LAST_TRAIN_RELAY_PARTS: Find parts for the signal relay
OBJ_LAST_TRAIN_RELAY_PARTS_HINT: Burned-out parts are listed on the relay cabinet. Search the depot and workshops.
OBJ_LAST_TRAIN_REPAIR_RELAY_HINT: Without signals the driver won't enter the station.
OBJ_LAST_TRAIN_CALL_EVAC_HINT: Line control can still reach the driver.
OBJ_LAST_TRAIN_SURVIVE: Hold the platform until the train arrives
OBJ_LAST_TRAIN_SURVIVE_HINT: You can hear it in the tunnel. Not the train.
OBJ_LAST_TRAIN_EXTRACT_HINT: The train stops past the east platform. Run.
OBJ_LAST_TRAIN_OPT_SERVER_HINT: The ticket office keeps the last hours of camera footage.
NOTE_LAST_TRAIN_1: Driver's radio, 00:12: Something on the track at km 3. It stood up. Not stopping again.
NOTE_LAST_TRAIN_2: Station notice: Line 4 suspended until further notice. Do not enter the tunnels for any reason.
NOTE_LAST_TRAIN_3: Cleaner's note: the drainage pumps keep clogging with something warm. Not rats. Too big for rats.
MISSION_OVERLOAD_DESC: The Halvard plant feeds half the region and its control rods are drifting. Open the coolant valves, rebuild the turbine controller and stabilise the core - with something in the turbine hall that likes the heat.
OBJ_OVERLOAD_GENERATOR_HINT: The generator room is marked on the wall plan. It will be loud.
OBJ_OVERLOAD_POWER_HINT: Throw the main breaker next to the generator.
OBJ_OVERLOAD_COOLANT_HINT: One of the pump rooms still has a working valve panel.
OBJ_OVERLOAD_CONTROLLER_PARTS: Find parts for the turbine controller
OBJ_OVERLOAD_CONTROLLER_PARTS_HINT: The stores and the workshop should have spares.
OBJ_OVERLOAD_REBUILD_CONTROLLER_HINT: The turbine hall is loud and open. Watch the dark between the turbines.
OBJ_OVERLOAD_STABILISE_HINT: Hold the core console until the rods settle.
OBJ_OVERLOAD_CALL_EVAC_HINT: The security radio reaches the fire brigade.
OBJ_OVERLOAD_OPT_SERVER_HINT: Someone ordered the plant to keep running. Find out who.
NOTE_OVERLOAD_1: Shift report: Turbine 2 vibrating at 3x tolerance. Maintenance says it's not mechanical. Maintenance went to look.
NOTE_OVERLOAD_2: Coolant line B temperature drop of 12 degrees at 02:10. Like something is drinking from it.
NOTE_OVERLOAD_3: ORDER FROM KESSLER LIAISON: Plant stays online. No evacuation. No press. - signature illegible
MISSION_DEEP_ARCHIVE_DESC: Kessler stored its founding research in the Meridian National Archive. Disable the lockdown, decrypt the vault index and pull three drives out of the stacks before the archive seals itself for good.
OBJ_DEEP_ARCHIVE_LOCKDOWN_HINT: Overriding it will trip the alarm. Be ready.
OBJ_DEEP_ARCHIVE_VAULT_KEY_HINT: The security terminal shows where it was last swiped.
OBJ_DEEP_ARCHIVE_DECRYPT_HINT: The index tells you which shelves hide the Kessler drives.
OBJ_DEEP_ARCHIVE_KESSLER_FILES_HINT: Three drives, marked on your map.
OBJ_DEEP_ARCHIVE_CALL_EVAC_HINT: The archivists' offices still have a landline.
OBJ_DEEP_ARCHIVE_EXTRACT_HINT: The van is waiting where you came in.
OBJ_DEEP_ARCHIVE_OPT_SERVER_HINT: Nobody needs to know you were here.
NOTE_DEEP_ARCHIVE_1: Deposit slip 1987: Kessler Foundation, 14 boxes, 'Subject H - origin'. Access: director only.
NOTE_DEEP_ARCHIVE_2: The stacks are colder near box 9. I keep hearing pages turning when nobody is there.
NOTE_DEEP_ARCHIVE_3: Lockdown protocol: if the vault is breached, all doors seal for 72 hours. Staff inside are on their own.
MISSION_QUARANTINE_DESC: Sector 7 grew the cultures that made THE HUNTER. The containment field is failing. Repair it, extract a live culture and get through decontamination before the sector is burned.
OBJ_QUARANTINE_GENERATOR_HINT: The generator room is marked on the wall plan. It will be loud.
OBJ_QUARANTINE_POWER_HINT: Throw the main breaker next to the generator.
OBJ_QUARANTINE_CULTURE_LOGS_HINT: They will tell you which culture is still alive.
OBJ_QUARANTINE_FIELD_PARTS: Find parts for the field generator
OBJ_QUARANTINE_FIELD_PARTS_HINT: Labs and supplies should have spares.
OBJ_QUARANTINE_REPAIR_FIELD_HINT: Without the field the vault won't open.
OBJ_QUARANTINE_EXTRACT_CULTURE_HINT: It will wake everything in the cells.
OBJ_QUARANTINE_CALL_EVAC: Tell them to hold the burn
OBJ_QUARANTINE_CALL_EVAC_HINT: The observation room radio reaches the burn team.
OBJ_QUARANTINE_OPT_DRIVES_HINT: Two drives with the full sequence.
NOTE_QUARANTINE_1: Culture H-7 doubled its mass overnight. It pressed against the glass when Dr. Ilić walked in.
NOTE_QUARANTINE_2: If the field fails: do NOT open the cells. Do NOT turn off the lights. It hates the cold, not the light. We were wrong.
NOTE_QUARANTINE_3: Burn order authorised for 05:00. Anyone still inside at 05:00 is classified as contaminated.
MISSION_PUMP_STATION_DESC: The river is rising and Pump Station 6 is dead. Close the flood valves, restart the main pump and hold on while the tunnels drain - whatever lives down there is coming up with the water.
OBJ_PUMP_STATION_GENERATOR_HINT: The generator room is marked on the wall plan. It will be loud.
OBJ_PUMP_STATION_POWER_HINT: Throw the main breaker next to the generator.
OBJ_PUMP_STATION_VALVE_B_HINT: Valve chamber B, at the east end.
OBJ_PUMP_STATION_PUMP_PARTS: Find parts for the main pump
OBJ_PUMP_STATION_RESTART_PUMP_HINT: The pump is loud. Everything in the tunnels will know.
OBJ_PUMP_STATION_CALL_EVAC_HINT: Pump control has the city radio.
OBJ_PUMP_STATION_SURVIVE: Hold out while the tunnels drain
OBJ_PUMP_STATION_SURVIVE_HINT: Something is coming up with the water.
OBJ_PUMP_STATION_OPT_SERVER_HINT: Something big blocked the intake last night.
NOTE_PUMP_STATION_1: Intake grate found bent OUTWARD. 40 mm steel. Nothing in the river can do that.
NOTE_PUMP_STATION_2: Crew: stay out of the sump tunnel. Marek went in for the radio and we heard him laughing. Marek never laughs.
NOTE_PUMP_STATION_3: Water temperature at intake: 19 C. River temperature: 4 C. Something warm is living in the pipes.
MISSION_BLACKOUT_TOWER_DESC: Vantage Tower is where Kessler's money men worked late. Restore power, pull the access logs and copy the executive server before the board's private security arrives to clean up.
OBJ_BLACKOUT_TOWER_REACH_ATRIUM_HINT: The atrium doors are jammed open.
OBJ_BLACKOUT_TOWER_POWER_HINT: Building services, south corridor. No generator - just the breaker.
OBJ_BLACKOUT_TOWER_ACCESS_LOGS_HINT: The security desk shows who was here last night.
OBJ_BLACKOUT_TOWER_EXEC_KEY_HINT: The logs show where it was used last.
OBJ_BLACKOUT_TOWER_COPY_SERVER_HINT: It takes time. The fans will spin up and everything will hear.
OBJ_BLACKOUT_TOWER_BACKUPS_HINT: Two drives the board kept off the network.
OBJ_BLACKOUT_TOWER_CALL_EVAC_HINT: The mail room line goes outside the building network.
OBJ_BLACKOUT_TOWER_OPT_SERVER: Erase your faces from the cameras
OBJ_BLACKOUT_TOWER_OPT_SERVER_HINT: The board's security will check the footage.
NOTE_BLACKOUT_TOWER_1: Board minutes: 'Liability for the Kessler incident will be transferred to the night staff.' Unanimous.
NOTE_BLACKOUT_TOWER_2: Cleaner, 23rd floor: someone is walking above the ceiling tiles. There is no 24th floor.
NOTE_BLACKOUT_TOWER_3: Security: lifts disabled by order of the board. Stairs locked. Nobody leaves until the auditors arrive.
MISSION_IRON_GATE_DESC: Blackmoor Penitentiary took Kessler's 'transfers'. One of them is still alive in solitary - and two of the things that came for him are walking the cell blocks.
OBJ_IRON_GATE_GENERATOR_HINT: The generator room is marked on the wall plan. It will be loud.
OBJ_IRON_GATE_POWER_HINT: Throw the main breaker next to the generator.
OBJ_IRON_GATE_TRANSFER_RECORD_HINT: Central control lists where the Kessler prisoner is held.
OBJ_IRON_GATE_MASTER_KEY_HINT: The warden kept one. Guards kept others.
OBJ_IRON_GATE_OPEN_BLOCK_C_HINT: It will open every cell at once.
OBJ_IRON_GATE_REACH_SOLITARY_HINT: The south wing. Whatever is left of him.
OBJ_IRON_GATE_CALL_EVAC_HINT: Central control can still reach the outside.
OBJ_IRON_GATE_OPT_DRIVES_HINT: Two drives with every Kessler transfer.
NOTE_IRON_GATE_1: Transfer 14 from Kessler: does not eat. Does not sleep. Asks every guard what time the night shift ends.
NOTE_IRON_GATE_2: Block A head count 02:00: 38. Block A head count 03:00: 38. Block A cell doors: all open.
NOTE_IRON_GATE_3: Warden: I have locked myself in. If you read this, the master key is in the drawer. Leave me here.
MISSION_GHOST_SIGNAL_DESC: Kestrel Ridge Observatory picked up a signal coming from under Kessler. It repeats the voices of the people who disappeared. Trace it, realign the dish and answer.
OBJ_GHOST_SIGNAL_GENERATOR_HINT: The generator room is marked on the wall plan. It will be loud.
OBJ_GHOST_SIGNAL_POWER_HINT: Throw the main breaker next to the generator.
OBJ_GHOST_SIGNAL_TRACE_HINT: The receiver room is recording it right now.
OBJ_GHOST_SIGNAL_DRIVE_PARTS: Find parts for the dish drive
OBJ_GHOST_SIGNAL_REALIGN_HINT: The drive motor is loud enough to hear in the valley.
OBJ_GHOST_SIGNAL_ANSWER_HINT: Hold the console. Whatever answers back, keep holding.
OBJ_GHOST_SIGNAL_CALL_EVAC_HINT: Staff quarters have the emergency radio.
NOTE_GHOST_SIGNAL_1: Signal log: 1420 MHz, repeating every 9 minutes. Today it said my name. In my mother's voice.
NOTE_GHOST_SIGNAL_2: The signal is not coming from space. Triangulation puts it 400 m under the Kessler facility.
NOTE_GHOST_SIGNAL_3: Director: do not answer it. It is not asking for help. It is learning how we talk.
MISSION_HOLLOW_MINE_DESC: Shaft 3 of the Gorska mine broke into a cavern nobody mapped. Eleven miners went silent. Find what's left of them, fix the lift winch and get everyone out of the dark.
OBJ_HOLLOW_MINE_REACH_LAMP_ROOM: Collect lamps in the lamp room
OBJ_HOLLOW_MINE_REACH_LAMP_ROOM_HINT: First door on the north gallery.
OBJ_HOLLOW_MINE_POWER_HINT: Throw the main breaker next to the generator.
OBJ_HOLLOW_MINE_FIND_MINERS_HINT: Their last position was at the collapse, east end of gallery 1.
OBJ_HOLLOW_MINE_FOREMAN_LOG_HINT: The foreman's hut. Find out what they broke into.
OBJ_HOLLOW_MINE_FIX_WINCH_HINT: The winch room is in the middle of the mine. Loud work.
OBJ_HOLLOW_MINE_CALL_EVAC_HINT: Use the lift console in the winch room.
OBJ_HOLLOW_MINE_SURVIVE: Hold out until the cage comes down
OBJ_HOLLOW_MINE_SURVIVE_HINT: The cage takes time. They don't.
OBJ_HOLLOW_MINE_EXTRACT: Ride the cage at the pithead
OBJ_HOLLOW_MINE_EXTRACT_HINT: Back to where you came down.
OBJ_HOLLOW_MINE_OPT_DRIVES_HINT: Two drives with the cavern survey.
NOTE_HOLLOW_MINE_1: Foreman: the drill broke through at 340 m. Warm air came out. It smelled like a hospital.
NOTE_HOLLOW_MINE_2: We counted eleven lamps going into the cavern. Twelve came back out.
NOTE_HOLLOW_MINE_3: Do not sit in the dark. If your lamp dies, sing. They don't like singing.
MISSION_SHELTER_TWELVE_DESC: Civil Defence Shelter 12 was sealed with three hundred people inside. The air filters stopped yesterday. Restart them, find the shelter roster and open the blast door from the inside.
OBJ_SHELTER_TWELVE_REACH_AIRLOCK_HINT: The emergency hatch leads into the airlock.
OBJ_SHELTER_TWELVE_GENERATOR_HINT: The generator room is marked on the wall plan. It will be loud.
OBJ_SHELTER_TWELVE_POWER_HINT: Throw the main breaker next to the generator.
OBJ_SHELTER_TWELVE_FILTER_PARTS: Find parts for the air filters
OBJ_SHELTER_TWELVE_RESTART_FILTERS_HINT: The filter hall is in the middle of the shelter.
OBJ_SHELTER_TWELVE_ROSTER_HINT: Shelter command. Find out how many are left.
OBJ_SHELTER_TWELVE_DOOR_KEY_HINT: The commander kept it in the armoury.
OBJ_SHELTER_TWELVE_LOGBOOKS_HINT: Two drives. Somebody has to know what happened here.
OBJ_SHELTER_TWELVE_CALL_EVAC_HINT: The airlock controls the main door.
OBJ_SHELTER_TWELVE_SURVIVE: Hold out while the door cycles
OBJ_SHELTER_TWELVE_SURVIVE_HINT: Two minutes of grinding steel. Everything heard it.
OBJ_SHELTER_TWELVE_EXTRACT: Get out through the blast door
OBJ_SHELTER_TWELVE_OPT_SERVER: Send the roster to the city
NOTE_SHELTER_TWELVE_1: Day 3: headcount 297. Day 4: headcount 297. Day 5: headcount 301. Nobody came in.
NOTE_SHELTER_TWELVE_2: Commander: dormitory A is closed. Do not ask why. Do not listen at the door.
NOTE_SHELTER_TWELVE_3: Child's drawing pinned to the wall: a tall grey man with too many fingers, holding everyone's hands.
MISSION_TOXIC_TIDE_DESC: Vel-Chem made the sedatives that kept THE HUNTER asleep. The plant is leaking and two of them are awake inside it. Seal the leak, run the scrubbers and synthesise one last batch.
OBJ_TOXIC_TIDE_GENERATOR_HINT: The generator room is marked on the wall plan. It will be loud.
OBJ_TOXIC_TIDE_POWER_HINT: Throw the main breaker next to the generator.
OBJ_TOXIC_TIDE_SEAL_LEAK_HINT: A valve in the reactor hall or the tank farm is stuck open.
OBJ_TOXIC_TIDE_RUN_SCRUBBERS_HINT: Clear the air before you synthesise.
OBJ_TOXIC_TIDE_SYNTHESISE_HINT: It takes time and it smells. They will come.
OBJ_TOXIC_TIDE_CARRY_BATCH_HINT: Last batch on earth. Don't drop it.
OBJ_TOXIC_TIDE_OPT_SERVER_HINT: Process control still has the full formula.
NOTE_TOXIC_TIDE_1: Batch 88 shipped to Kessler 18:00. Batch 89 cancelled by order. Subject dosage halved 'to observe behaviour'.
NOTE_TOXIC_TIDE_2: Tank 4 is leaking upward. Liquid does not leak upward.
NOTE_TOXIC_TIDE_3: Chemist: it sleeps when the dose is right. It dreams when the dose is low. We are in its dream now.
MISSION_FINAL_SHIFT_DESC: Everything leads back to Kessler. Under the facility is the nest where THE HUNTER was made - and where more are growing. Rebuild the containment grid, seal the nest and walk out at dawn.
OBJ_FINAL_SHIFT_REACH_CHECKPOINT_HINT: The service lift brought you down. Go east.
OBJ_FINAL_SHIFT_GENERATOR_HINT: The deep generator is in the south wing.
OBJ_FINAL_SHIFT_POWER_HINT: Throw the main breaker next to the generator.
OBJ_FINAL_SHIFT_DEEP_SECURITY_HINT: The checkpoint terminal controls the secure doors.
OBJ_FINAL_SHIFT_DIRECTOR_KEY_HINT: The director never left the deep labs.
OBJ_FINAL_SHIFT_ORIGIN: Find out where it came from
OBJ_FINAL_SHIFT_ORIGIN_HINT: The origin servers hold the first entry.
OBJ_FINAL_SHIFT_GRID_PARTS: Find parts for the containment grid
OBJ_FINAL_SHIFT_REBUILD_GRID_HINT: Either junction will do. Both are watched.
OBJ_FINAL_SHIFT_SEAL_NEST_HINT: Hold the nest console until the seals lock. They will all come.
OBJ_FINAL_SHIFT_CALL_EVAC_HINT: The observation deck reaches the surface team.
OBJ_FINAL_SHIFT_SURVIVE_HINT: Ninety seconds to sunrise. It ends tonight.
OBJ_FINAL_SHIFT_EXTRACT_HINT: The surface exit is open. The night shift is over.
OBJ_FINAL_SHIFT_OPT_DRIVES_HINT: Two drives with everything Kessler hid.
NOTE_FINAL_SHIFT_1: Entry 1, 1986: Found it in the cavern under the mine. It was sleeping. It was cold. We warmed it up.
NOTE_FINAL_SHIFT_2: Director: the nursery has six. They learn from the first one. They learn from us. They learned the night shift schedule.
NOTE_FINAL_SHIFT_3: If you are reading this, you made it further than any of us. Seal the nest. Then go home. Please go home.
